tools.name: desk_read
tools.description: Descriptive liquidation walls, cascade path, crowd and position distance. Free data is 2 hours behind. Availability depends on customer access.

tools.name: hk_levels
tools.description: Call when a user asks for liquidation levels around the price of a supported coin. No key needed, 2 hours behind. Returns hk.levels.v1 liquidation levels from Bybit perpetual walls, with snapshot age, delay and evidence labels, using six Free coins delayed by 2 hours without a key.

tools.name: get_proof_summary
tools.description: Call when a user wants to inspect the published record and its sample sizes. No key needed, 2 hours behind. Returns the public proof summary with sample sizes, confidence bounds and evidence links from the published scorecard and feed reconciliation record.

tools.name: get_magnet_levels_teaser
tools.description: Call when a user asks for the largest delayed liquidation clusters around BTC or ETH. No key needed, 2 hours behind. Returns the three largest liquidation clusters per side for BTC and ETH from one public snapshot delayed by 2 hours.

tools.name: get_feed_trust_summary
tools.description: Call when a user asks how the public liquidation feed is checked against venues. No key needed, 2 hours behind. Returns venue verdicts, match rates, coverage and sample counts from the public liquidation feed reconciliation audit.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: Call when a user wants to choose a supported coin before requesting levels. No key needed, 2 hours behind. Returns six Free coins without a key or the supported symbol allowlist with a key, including the applicable delay.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Call after a tool response when a user wants to report a service issue. No key needed, 2 hours behind. Stores the caller's service feedback and returns its receipt using the same validation and internal review queue as the public feedback form.

tools.name: subscribe_events
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user needs an event stream connection descriptor without opening a connection. Returns a protected event stream connection descriptor and replay cursor for recorded liquidation cascades and wall changes, without opening a connection.

tools.name: get_liquidation_census
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user asks how liquidation exposure is distributed across venue price bands. Returns aggregate liquidation price bands, venue coverage and snapshot age from the Hyperliquid position census, with no individual account rows.

tools.name: get_liquidation_magnets
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user needs liquidation clusters across time horizons. Returns per horizon liquidation magnets and historical reach rates with sample sizes and confidence bounds from the published calibrated record.

tools.name: get_reach_stats
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user asks how published price bands were reached in the historical record. Returns historical band reach rates by symbol and horizon with sample sizes and confidence intervals from the walk forward record.

tools.name: get_feed_trust
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user needs the detailed venue reconciliation record. Returns per venue verdicts, coverage and sample counts for the service's liquidation feed from its recorded reconciliation checks.

tools.name: get_accuracy_proof
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user wants the published measurement record and comparison windows. Returns the published track record with sample sizes, baselines and measurement windows from the same aggregate as the public proof page.

tools.name: get_engine_read
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user requests descriptive engine context for a symbol and horizon. Returns unvalidated directional context for a symbol and horizon from the customer engine read payload as descriptive context, not a forecast.

tools.name: get_proof_anchors
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user wants to check the dates and content digests of published records. Returns dates, content digests and chain hashes from the public daily proof anchor ledger, excluding private signatures and signing keys.

tools.name: get_decision_packet
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user needs a combined view of liquidation levels and venue context. Returns liquidation magnets, historical reach, venue structure and feed trust from the existing evidence readers, with unavailable components labeled.

tools.name: prepare_trade
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user supplies levels and wants position sizing without placing an order. Returns position quantity, notional and optional gross reward to risk from user supplied levels and an evidence packet, without placing or signing an order.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Needs an API key. Call when a user wants a checkout link for a prepaid data credit pack. Creates and returns a Stripe Checkout URL for a selected prepaid data credit pack from the configured catalog, leaving payment completion to the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_proof_summary, get_feed_trust_summary, get_feed_trust, get_decision_packet · Private data: get_proof_summary, subscribe_events, get_liquidation_census, get_liquidation_magnets, get_reach_stats, get_feed_trust, get_accuracy_proof, get_engine_read, get_proof_anchors, get_decision_packet, prepare_trade, buy_credits · Public sink: get_reach_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_proof_summary, get_feed_trust_summary, get_feed_trust, get_decision_packet · Private data: get_proof_summary, subscribe_events, get_liquidation_census, get_liquidation_magnets, get_reach_stats, get_feed_trust, get_accuracy_proof, get_engine_read, get_proof_anchors, get_decision_packet, prepare_trade, buy_credits · Public sink: get_reach_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "subscribe_events" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Call when a user needs an event stream connection descriptor without opening a connection. Returns a protected event stream connection descriptor and replay cursor for recorded liquidation cascades and wall changes, without opening a connection."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
